long_biography.plain_text:
Cotton and wet wipes sit at the centre of Constantina Evangeliou’s work at Septona. Under her leadership, the company built a factory for the non-woven material used in wipes, aiming to control costs throughout production. Its manufacturing combines Septona-branded goods with products made for retailers and other consumer brands.

Evangeliou has made equal employment opportunities part of her management agenda. She considers fair access to professional development a measure of organisational maturity and values employees’ abilities irrespective of gender. In 2021, women held nearly half of Septona’s senior management posts.
